_doc: Markings/pattern axis (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES §2) — universal: every animal can bear markings, catalogued or not. Generic words read across surfaces (a spotted bird, a striped snake); surface-specific pattern wording ('barred plumage') is a deferred refinement (§11.4). PLACEHOLDER FRAGMENTS (§2/§11.2): the look owner sets the words and the Phase 3 calibration pass tunes them against real 160 px renders — the §12 Tier C bar is that every option is LIVE, non-destructive, and subject-preserving, not that it renders exactly as named. clause_slot 20: prefix adjective, outside body's slot 10.
label: markings
